desk_flags.title: Band and floor intersect in a 1.4-point window
desk_flags.detail: The brief asks for High confidence above 70% and a fair price between -250 and +10000. A -250 fair price is 71.43%, so any selection above that is excluded by the price rule. Lines are therefore originated at the 70.1-71.3% quantile, and every High price prints between -235 and -248. This is disclosed rather than hidden.

desk_flags.title: Quota of five High picks per sport is not reached
desk_flags.detail: Ten High selections exist across four sports. Nine sports have none. The reasons are per-sport: no OLBG event card (golf, rugby league match markets), blocked or missing official data (darts, handball), too few events (baseball, tennis), or the official fixture set not matching the OLBG card (cricket). No pick was invented to fill a quota.

desk_flags.title: Kick-off timezone unresolved for two Rugby League rows
desk_flags.detail: NRL.com lists New Zealand v Cook Islands at 1:05am and Australia v Fiji at 5:05am on Sunday 25 October without stating the timezone. The UTC cell is left blank on both rows rather than guessed.

desk_flags.title: Snooker start time differs between two official-adjacent sources
desk_flags.detail: The WST match list prints the semi-final at 14:00 while the OLBG card prints 18:05Z. One clock is being rendered in a different timezone. The UTC cell is flagged and the WST match is still listed.

desk_flags.title: OLBG cricket card does not match the official CSA fixture hub
desk_flags.detail: OLBG lists North West Dragons v Northern Cape Heat and Tuskers v Western Province as T20 fixtures. The Cricket South Africa hub for the same date lists Colts three-day matches and a Pro 50 women's game. The rows are published as discovery only, with no line.

desk_flags.title: Golf hub empty
desk_flags.detail: OLBG's Golf hub returned 'No tips found' at 17:24Z. The page documents outright, first-round-leader and top-region markets, but no event card or selection existed to originate a line against, so Golf is published with zero fixtures rather than invented ones.

desk_flags.title: Volleyball and handball official routes did not render
desk_flags.detail: The EHF Champions League and EHF matches routes return 404, and both HBL schedule routes return a reCAPTCHA page. The affected rows are discovery-only.

desk_flags.title: PDC tournament hub is behind a consent wall
desk_flags.detail: Two fetches of the PDC European Championship hub returned cookie-consent text only. The five dart rows therefore carry no draw, no order of play and no line.

desk_flags.title: OLA desk prices are our own estimates, not bookmaker quotes
desk_flags.detail: Every price on this site is a zero-vig fair price derived from the inputs shown on the row. No bookmaker price was copied, and no availability or edge claim is made.

repo_findings.finding: 103 task-board rows contain 15 duplicated task IDs (T1-T7, T63, T64, T424375B4, T496E, T65331685, T5821, T7A9B, T9965).
repo_findings.why: A duplicated ID makes 'who owns what' ambiguous, which is the one thing the board exists to prevent. Detected by regex over table rows.

repo_findings.finding: The canonical root snapshot is stamped 2026-10-22T12:29:50Z with 108 listings, 72 outcomes and 0 High picks, while later desks publish dozens of High picks.
repo_findings.why: A visitor landing on the root sees a two-day-old desk that reports zero High selections, next to 56 desk directories that report many. This is the presentation inconsistency the brief complains about.

repo_findings.finding: 56 eight-character desk directories and 20 root HTML pages coexist. Each desk re-publishes its own navigation.
repo_findings.why: There is no single front door. Any new desk must therefore be self-describing and link back to the root, which this one does.

repo_findings.finding: The 23 October desk lists 'Basilashvili v Tsitsipas' and 'Medvedev v Bublik' as ATP Almaty semi-finals at 10:00Z and 13:00Z on 24 October. The official ATP order of play for Day 9 shows the final as Medvedev v Basilashvili.
repo_findings.why: Both semi-final pairings cannot still be correct. The rows are stale within 24 hours, which shows why this desk stamps every fixture with a read time and an expiry.

repo_findings.finding: 51 predictions, minimum 39 words, no occurrence of the internal terms. This is compliant and is recorded so the good state is not lost.
repo_findings.why: Positive control: it shows the house style can be met at scale.

repo_findings.finding: No git conflict markers, no tracked .pyc files, and zero broken local links across index, picks, predictions, sports and flagged pages.
repo_findings.why: Recorded as a clean baseline for the next session.
